label: ex:rieffel-quotient-temperley-lieb
title: Temperley--Lieb trace-radical quotient on two-dimensional strands
html:
Continuing the \mathrm{SU}(2) fundamental representation on V = \mathbb{C}^2, let H_n(q) act on the n-fold tensor power V^{\otimes n} via Michio Jimbo's R-matrix representation [jimbo1986] for nonzero q \in \mathbb{C} satisfying q^k \neq 1 for every k \ge 1, equipped with the Jones--Markov trace \tau_q at parameter z = q^3/(q^2 + 1).

For n = 1 and n = 2, the representation on V^{\otimes n} is faithful and the trace radical \mathrm{rad}\,\tau_q = \{x \in H_n(q) : \tau_q(x y) = 0 \text{ for all } y \in H_n(q)\} vanishes identically. For every n \ge 3, because \dim V = 2, no nonzero alternating three-tensor exists in V^{\otimes n}; the kernel of the Jimbo action coincides as a two-sided ideal with \mathrm{rad}\,\tau_q \neq 0, generated by the three-strand q-antisymmetriser. Sending the quotient image of each braid generator \sigma_i to q - e_i establishes an isomorphism of \mathbb{C}-algebras

  H_n(q) / \mathrm{rad}\,\tau_q
  \;\cong\;
  TL_n(q + q^{-1})

onto the planar Temperley--Lieb algebra [temperley-lieb1971] of Catalan dimension C_n = \frac{1}{n+1}\binom{2n}{n}, whose representation on V^{\otimes n} is faithful. By Rieffel quotient faithfulness, any Lipschitz seminorm represented through V^{\otimes n} has non-scalar kernel on H_n(q) for n \ge 3, whereas descending to the trace-radical quotient TL_n(q + q^{-1}) restores a scalar kernel \mathbb{C} \cdot 1 and a finite Kantorovich--Rubinstein metric on the state space [rieffel1999].
